g.text: Drawn with the reference pack's garage assets (stall and bay sizes from the Pecos layout). The positions are invented: the Pecos YAML was not part of the reference material. The 5 m bar under the floor gives the scale.

g.text: A small part of an automated parking garage, top-down, at the start of the worked example (t = 0). Everything the algorithms see is the graph of dots and lines; the rest is there so you know what the dots stand for.
